question: D-STRAT1-TACLAT-F1: nav echo or skill cost
evidence_class: MEASURED (ours; banked T1-kin dumps, zero training, CPU)
tier: T1-kin tick 0 (lateral head argmax at the window's first tick under the T1 feed: dead-reckoned nav, logged scene) vs the v9 label lat_cls (5-way); the nav-only predictor sees only nav_in at that tick
estimator: episode-cluster bootstrap (taniteval.ci, stat / paired stat), B=2000, seed 0, 141 episodes; 'another draw of EPISODES' only; training-run variance = floor F = |C0_rep - C0_s0|

K-UNION.reading: confusion(split) + confusion(complement) equals the full-set confusion for every arm; full-set macro-F1 equals the landed RESULT_FAM_EXTRA.json to 1e-12

K1_self_pair.reading: the head against itself on UNINF_BOTH reads exactly 0.0 [0.0, 0.0] on every cell

K-SHUFFLE.reading: a nav permuted across windows must read near the majority baseline (|diff| <= 0.08, fixed before the run)

definition.UNINF_BOTH: neither the v9 nor the text nav token at tick 0 names a turn (FOLLOW or no row): the committed read, the only set where no arm has route information
definition.INF_ANY: at least one feed names a turn (complement of UNINF_BOTH)
definition.UNINF_V9: C0's own v9 token names no turn
definition.INF_V9: C0's own v9 token names a turn

nav_only_predictor.definition: best fixed map nav key -> lat class (majority label per key); fit on one half of the EPISODES, scored on the other, halves swapped; key = token (FOLLOW / TURN_L / TURN_R / no row); the sensitivity adds a distance bin (channel 3 x 100 m, edges 30 / 60 / 100, invalid = own bin)
nav_only_predictor.tier: T1-kin tick 0 (lateral head argmax at the window's first tick under the T1 feed: dead-reckoned nav, logged scene) vs the v9 label lat_cls (5-way); the nav-only predictor sees only nav_in at that tick

reading.rule: ECHO: nav-only >= 90 % of C0's head macro-F1 at s0 and s1 AND the S1 - C0 gap on UNINF_BOTH not separated at either; SKILL-COST: gap separated, same sign, at both; else MIXED
